release plans and diffs expose component dependencies, API bindings, authority findings, and preservation decisions

missing: one versioned generic batch envelope shared by all producers

checklist.line: approve/reject/edit, stale invalidation, undo/redo, cancellation, timeout-as-unknown, reread-before-retry, and recovery receipts
implemented: transaction and staged-executor state machines require exact approval and model timeout or transport uncertainty as unknown outcome
transaction journal persistence blocks retry after uncertain durable append and requires reread
staged Foundry recovery performs explicit authoritative reread before resolution
Scene history supports deterministic monotonic undo and redo
Campaign Director conversations support cancellation and retry without granting execution
project-store approval paths reject stale generation, content hash, identity, and preview state
missing: generic reject and edit transitions with durable history
generic cancellation after approval but before dispatch
cross-producer stale invalidation and normalized recovery receipts
undo/redo semantics for producers other than the in-memory Scene history
one lifecycle that prevents producer-specific transition drift

checklist.line: human controls, Campaign Director proposals, Technical Builder patches, and Foundry plans share one review vocabulary without sharing authority
implemented: human and AI-fixture Scene edits converge on SceneCommand execution
Campaign Director proposals remain no-write and approval-required
Technical Builder jobs remain isolated and explicitly require reviewed integration
Foundry execution independently requires exact current active-GM authority
missing: one shared producer-neutral review vocabulary and status model
explicit authority-domain separation within that shared vocabulary
adapters that normalize each producer into the common batch without broadening its authority

checklist.line: acceptance: every mutating path has preview, explicit approval, deterministic execution, authoritative reread, and recoverable history
implemented: project-store and Foundry staged paths have exact preview, explicit approval, deterministic mutation gates, and authoritative reread
journal execution preserves unknown outcome and recovery boundaries
SceneCommand execution has deterministic receipts and undo/redo history
missing: complete inventory-backed proof that every mutating path participates
shared durable history covering preview through recovery for all producers
direct acceptance observation across human, Director, Technical Builder, project-store, and Foundry plan adapters

producerInventory.payload: Foundry IR plan and staged transaction journal
producerInventory.authority: exact runtime profile plus current active GM
producerInventory.schemaGap: strongest execution lifecycle remains Foundry-specific and has no generic reject/edit/undo adapter

authorityVocabularyConflicts: SceneCommand origin identifies human or AI-fixture provenance but is not an approval authority.
Campaign Director approvalRequired expresses review state but never grants project or Foundry authority.
Technical Builder integration review governs repository promotion and cannot authorize project or runtime mutation.
project-store approved booleans authorize one exact local persistence operation but do not represent GM authority.
compiler previews use authority none/gm while staged execution requires exact approvedByUserId equal to activeGmUserId.
These concepts must be normalized as distinct review, execution, and target-authority fields rather than collapsed into one approved flag.

smallestMissingVerticalSlice.scope: Add a runtime-neutral, versioned generic proposal-batch schema and pure transition engine with producer/source/provider metadata, authority domain, risk, ordered command dependencies, deterministic content hash, preview state, approve/reject/edit/cancel/stale transitions, timeout-as-unknown, reread-before-retry recovery, and append-only normalized receipts. Keep producer payloads opaque and typed by adapters; do not integrate any mutation path yet.
smallestMissingVerticalSlice.reason: Every Stage 11 clause is blocked by vocabulary and lifecycle drift. A pure shared core is the smallest dependency that can normalize review without merging authority or changing product/runtime state.
